name: Bloody Valentine
source:
You play as a character who goes to a martial arts academy. Since its Valentine's Day, your goal is to give a chocolate to a guy who happens to be the school idol, so there are many challenges ahead of you...

[Edited from [url=http://mirukutea.deviantart.com/art/Bloody-Valentine-154643926]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个去武术学院学习的角色。由于是情人节，你的目标是给一个恰好是校园偶像的人一块巧克力，所以你面前有很多挑战……

[编辑自[url=http://mirukutea.deviantart.com/art/Bloody-Valentine-154643926]DeviantArt[/url]]
